# `browser-extension/services/WebMCPBridgeRuntime.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/browser-extension/services/WebMCPBridgeRuntime.js`

WebMCPBridgeRuntime.js - clean-room, versioned adapter between AI Echo and the browser's evolving WebMCP surface. Page-owned metadata and results are always untrusted. The extension never exposes callbacks, Window objects, or credentials across the OS bridge.

## Functions

### `normalizeBrowserWebMCPRequest(request = {})`

Validate one bridge request before any page script is dispatched.

### `async runBrowserWebMCPAction(request)`

Packaged Chrome scripting entry point. It deliberately feature-detects the origin-trial API, because WebMCP is still a Community Group draft and the browser execution helper is not yet part of the portable specification.

## Constants

- `BROWSER_WEBMCP_PROTOCOL` — WebMCPBridgeRuntime.js - clean-room, versioned adapter between AI Echo and the browser's evolving WebMCP surface. Page-owned metadata and results are always untrusted. The extension never exposes callbacks, Window objects, or credentials across the OS bridge.
